@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from ._textwrap import TextWrapper
+
+
+class CrlfIndentedText(TextWrapper):
+    """A :class:`TextWrapper` whose :meth:`indent_only` joins the indented
+    lines with CRLF instead of LF.
+    """
+
+    def indent_only(self, text: str) -> str:
+        rv = []
+
+        for idx, line in enumerate(text.splitlines()):
+            indent = self.initial_indent
+
+            if idx > 0:
+                indent = self.subsequent_indent
+
+            rv.append(f"{indent}{line}")
+
+        return "\r\n".join(rv)
diff --git a/tests/test_crlf_indented_text.py b/tests/test_crlf_indented_text.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5237427
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_crlf_indented_text.py
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+from click._textwrap import TextWrapper
+from click.crlf_indented_text import CrlfIndentedText
+
+
+def test_indent_only_uses_crlf():
+    w = CrlfIndentedText(initial_indent="> ", subsequent_indent="  ")
+    assert w.indent_only("a\nb\r\nc") == "> a\r\n  b\r\n  c"
+
+
+def test_indent_only_matches_base_except_separator():
+    kwargs = dict(initial_indent="1", subsequent_indent="2")
+    text = "x\ny\n\nz"
+    expected = TextWrapper(**kwargs).indent_only(text).replace("\n", "\r\n")
+    assert CrlfIndentedText(**kwargs).indent_only(text) == expected
+    assert CrlfIndentedText().indent_only("") == ""
+
+
+def test_extra_indent_inherited():
+    w = CrlfIndentedText()
+    with w.extra_indent("  "):
+        assert w.indent_only("a\nb") == "  a\r\n  b"
notes:
Added CrlfIndentedText subclassing click._textwrap.TextWrapper, overriding indent_only with identical logic but joining with CRLF (base uses no super() call or decorators on indent_only); added tests.
